completion_criteria: The wooden cube is no longer in contact with the tray surface.
The cube is visibly elevated above the blue tray.
The right gripper is the apparent agent holding or lifting the cube.
The tray remains in its original tabletop position.
failure_modes: Cube remains resting on the tray.
Cube moves laterally but is not lifted above the tray.
Cube appears floating without contact or plausible control by the right gripper.
Left gripper performs the lift instead of the right gripper.
Tray or table moves along with the cube.
Camera pans, zooms, cuts, or changes angle.
Unrelated lab objects shift, disappear, or change appearance.
Cube is replaced, duplicated, deformed, or changes material.

initial_state.camera: fixed third-person view of the robot lab scene
initial_state.cube: resting on the floor of the blue tray near its center
initial_state.right_gripper: positioned above and near the cube, open or ready to grasp

intended_change.description: The right gripper grasps and lifts the wooden cube upward so the cube is suspended above the blue tray instead of resting on it.
intended_change.state_delta: cube support/contact changes from tray-supported to gripper-held, with the cube's vertical position increased to clearly above the tray rim or tray floor

negative_constraints: Do not move the camera or change perspective.
Do not move, resize, recolor, or replace the tray.
Do not teleport the cube; it should be lifted by the right gripper.
Do not have the left gripper lift or interact with the cube.
Do not add or remove unrelated objects.
Do not alter unrelated scene anchors.
Do not spill, deform, break, or duplicate the cube.
Do not move the cube outside the visible working area unless still clearly held above the tray.
protected_anchors: blue tray position, shape, and orientation
left robot arm and left gripper
right robot base and non-gripper arm structure except for necessary lifting motion
background cabinets, windows, monitor, and lab objects
